description: This file defines a Fragment named HomeFragment in an Android application, which displays AI-driven sharing suggestions retrieved from SuggestionEngine. It handles view creation, binds a RecyclerView to show suggestions, and manages UI visibility based on whether suggestions are available. It also contains an adapter class for rendering suggestion items.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class that displays suggestions to the user based on AI analysis, managing UI components like RecyclerView and handling visibility logic.

classes.name: SuggestionAdapter
classes.description: Inner class adapter for RecyclerView that binds a list of suggestion strings to views.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView, loads suggestions, and updates UI visibility based on suggestion list.

methods.name: SuggestionAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances by inflating item layout.

methods.name: SuggestionAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds suggestion string data to the TextView in ViewHolder.
